text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — gated benchmark report + companion webinar scheduled Tue 9am PT. Need SEO action items (keywords, schema, redirects, internal linking), plus inbound lead routing and tracking. Who can own the SEO checklist?
Maya: I can take SEO checklist. First pass: keyword mapping + landing page titles/meta, structured data for report, and redirect map for old blog posts.
Liam: I'll do inbound routing — decide form vs. webinar sign-up flow, HubSpot fields, and UTM mapping. Also we need to tag leads with "Benchmark-Webinar-Apr2026".
Sophie: I'll own the launch page copy + CTAs — can use keyword list from Maya. Need canonical URL + ensure the webinar page is included in the sitemap.
Raj: Quick infra note: if we gate report behind SSO, make sure crawler access is open to Googlebot on the summary page. For gating we should have an open "summary" page with schema.
Maya: Suggested schema: Article + ReportObject (we can use JSON-LD). Example:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Report",
  "name": "Redwood Inference benchmark: cost & latency",
  "datePublished": "2026-04-07",
  "author": {"@type": "Organization","name": "Redwood Inference"}
}
```
Maya: I'll drop a full schema file into the drive.
Alex: Redirects — we have two existing blog posts that should point to the landing page. Can we do 301s and update internal links?
Sophie: Yes. I'll update in-content links. Raj, can you queue 301 redirects with infra? Here's proposed mapping:
```text
/blog/2024/cost-high-performance -> /benchmarks/cost-latency-apr-2026
/blog/2025/model-serving-best-practices -> /benchmarks/cost-latency-apr-2026
```
Raj: Yep, will add to redirect config (nginx + CDN). Will need a ticket with exact paths and QA steps.
Liam: For lead routing: prefer form->HS->segment trait. Form fields: name, email, company, job_title, use_case, consent checkbox. UTM tags required.
marketing-bot: Reminder: content calendar slot confirmed — 2026-04-08 publish (summary + webinar landing). :calendar:
Maya: Next steps: I'll share keyword matrix and a prioritized list (primary/secondary). Sophie will draft meta titles. Raj, please create redirect ticket. Liam, set up HS form and automation to tag leads.
Alex: Awesome. Can we reconvene tomorrow 10am PT for preflight? @everyone :eyes: 
Sophie: 10am works for me.
Maya: Works.
Liam: Works.
Raj: Works.
Alex: Great — thanks all.
